selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What do all created things show by the way they exist and appear?
questions.answer: They show that Allah is One.

questions.question: How can things be together but still be different from each other?
questions.answer: They can belong to one world but each one still has its own special form.

questions.question: What does it mean that some things are like small or big versions of other things?
questions.answer: It means they match in pattern even if their size is different.

questions.question: What are the two groups named in the passage: large groups and single members?
questions.answer: Kinds and species are the large groups, and individuals are the single members.

questions.question: What do similar natural patterns in living things help people understand?
questions.answer: They help people understand that one Maker made them.

questions.question: What do similar signs of art in things teach us?
questions.answer: They teach us that the same Creator designed them.

questions.question: How do things help one another in their jobs in creation?
questions.answer: They support and complete each other.

questions.question: What does all this teamwork in creation prove?
questions.answer: It proves the unity of their Maker.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the whole universe?
questions.answer: It is one complete whole, not broken into separate owners.

questions.question: According to the verse, how easy are creating people and raising them again for Allah?
questions.answer: It is as easy as creating and raising one soul.

questions.question: What is the main truth taught in this passage?
questions.answer: All beings clearly point to the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: Why does likeness between many created things matter?
questions.answer: It shows one plan and one Maker.

questions.question: If things can be both joined in one world and also each be separate, what does that suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests wise order from one Creator.

questions.question: What does it mean when some things are general groups and some are single examples?
questions.answer: It means creation has levels, from big kinds to one-by-one members.

questions.question: Why is it important that many things share the same built-in pattern?
questions.answer: Because shared patterns point to one Designer.

questions.question: What does it mean that things have similar marks of art?
questions.answer: They carry signs of the same beautiful making.

questions.question: Why is the helping of one thing by another important in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that creation works together under one rule.

questions.question: What does the passage say these signs establish about the Maker?
questions.answer: They establish that the Maker is one.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s care over the universe?
questions.answer: His care covers the whole universe as one complete order.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the verse at the end?
questions.answer: Allah can create and bring back everyone as easily as one person.

questions.question: Who is being pointed to by the many signs in all beings?
questions.answer: Allah, the one Maker.

questions.question: Name one kind of sign in the passage that points to Allah’s unity.
questions.answer: Many things resemble each other.

questions.question: Name another sign in the passage that points to Allah’s unity.
questions.answer: Some things are like smaller or larger forms of others.

questions.question: What do groups, kinds, and single living things together show?
questions.answer: They show one connected system of creation.
